claim_under_attack: amphora-ip-fto-guard/evidence/audit/: Patent family ownership chains in patent_landscape.json are current and correctly attributed (R-S03), for the 6 claim-charted families.

corroboration.finding: Blue Cube Spinco Inc.'s SEC-registered address matches Olin Corporation's SEC-registered address (190 Carondelet Plaza, Suite 1530, Clayton, MO), and Wikipedia (citing contemporary reporting) states Olin completed acquisition of Dow's Global Epoxy business unit on 2015-10-05. Blue Cube entities, including the IP-holding affiliate 'Blue Cube IP LLC', are therefore domiciled with / controlled by Olin Corporation, not Dow, as of that date.
corroboration.question: Is 'Blue Cube IP LLC' (assignee for families n=1, n=3) a Dow entity or an Olin Corporation entity as of the 2015 Dow chlorine/epoxy-business divestiture?

sources_consulted.quote: October 5, 2015, Olin successfully acquired Dow's U.S. Gulf Coast Chlor-Alkali and Vinyl, Global Chlorinated Organics, and Global Epoxy business units
sources_consulted.source: Wikipedia: Olin Corporation, section 'Spinoffs and joint ventures (2015-2022)'
SEC EDGAR company search: 'Blue Cube Spinco Inc.' (CIK 0001640811) registered business address
SEC EDGAR company search: 'Olin Corporation' registered business address

register_attempts.evidence: HTTP 403 on all 3 application-number lookups; response body and headers show Cloudflare bot challenge (server: cloudflare, cf-ray present, no legal-events/proprietor data returned).

HTTP 301 redirect to https://data.uspto.gov/support/transition-guide/patentsview, a client-side-rendered page that injects an AWS WAF JS challenge (edge.sdk.awswaf.com/.../challenge.js) before any content renders; the legacy free-query endpoint is retired and its successor is not fetchable by unauthenticated headless HTTP.

DNS NXDOMAIN for all 4 legacy assignment-search hostnames on this network (getent hosts fails); search.patentsview.org (current PatentsView search UI, requires a registered API key per USPTO's published transition guide) is likewise unresolvable.

rows.rationale: json assignee 'Blue Cube IP LLC' matches the live Google Patents current-assignee field, and no contradicting register evidence was found, but this entity's IP was part of a 2015 corporate divestiture (family n=1's own assignee 'Blue Cube IP LLC' is a direct spinoff product; family n=4's 'Dow Global Technologies LLC' covers chemistry -- chlorinated polyolefin epoxy overcoatability -- that falls within the same divested Global Epoxy business scope) and neither authoritative register (EPO, USPTO) is reachable from this environment to confirm no further, un-recorded-at-Google assignment has since occurred. Confidence is LOW, not a positive finding of currency.
rows.source_consulted: Google Patents biblio page (aggregator; EPO Register and USPTO PatentsView/assignment search both attempted and blocked -- see register_attempts)
